items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: The last time I played with Lorenzo. Yeah. ... Lorenzo Tio and George Bacchia. We were the only three clarinet players in your league.

ctx.x: And do you remember when musicians that you were playing with yourself first started to call themselves jazz bands? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

Yeah. Yeah. But I was one of the leader. You know? Sure. That led them to that. Yeah. True jazz. Did you have any connection, any friendly connection or anything with some of the other clarinet players in those times like Lorenzo and I was playing with the jazz?
Yeah. George Bacchia. Yeah. George Bacchia. Yes. Lorenzo Tio and George Bacchia. We were the only three clarinet players in your league.
